shortDescription: Private equity investor Blackstone NYSE:BX is preparing an initial public offering for Spain's Hotel Investment Partners by late October or early November, newspaper Cinco Dias reported on Wednesday, citing unnamed sources close to the process.($1 = 0.8646 euros)

children: is preparing an initial public offering for Spain's Hotel Investment Partners by late October or early November, newspaper Cinco Dias reported on Wednesday, citing unnamed sources close to the process.
Barcelona-based HIP owns a portfolio of 61 hotels and 20,000 rooms across Spain, Greece, Italy and Portugal, which Cinco Dias said is valued at around €6 billion ($6.94 billion).
Blackstone is preparing to submit the request to the Spanish stock market regulator CNMV by the beginning of October, the newspaper added.
According to Cinco Dias, Blackstone is aiming to divest its 65% stake in the company.
Blackstone also expects to carry out a €700 million capital increase at the debut, the newspaper said.
Singapore sovereign wealth fund GIC owns the rest of the company.
The process is backed by Santander, Morgan Stanley, Citi, BNP Paribas and Goldman Sachs, among others, Cinco Dias said.
HIP, which acquires, repositions and manages hotels, did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Neither did Singapore's GIC. Blackstone declined to comment.
Blackstone acquired HIP from Banco Sabadell
